text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since Matikanetannhauser wasn't feeling well,
I decided to have her rest in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer.
For causing you so much worry.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'll get plenty of rest and recharge completely.
Well then, good niiight~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Mmh, hmm?
Where is this... umm...

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back~.
You're gonna get plenty of rest today, riiiight?

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Father
text_block_list.text:
I've got your favorite full-course meal ready too.
Eat up and fill your belly!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what...!?
Why are Mom and Dad here!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
No, more importantly, a full-course meal...?
We're supposed to be a simple diner...

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Father
text_block_list.text:
Here you go, your favorite
sea urchin soupe de poisson,
and pan-seared sea bream for the main dish~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wah-wah...! I've never seen any of these dishes before!?

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about? You've always had a huge
weakness for full-course French dinners, haven't you~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I've never eaten any of these before!
What on earth is sea urchin 'poiw-poiw'~?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I want the usual set meal...!
It's simply delicious, brings simple happiness, and without that taste, it just isn't home!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: So give me back "normal taste," God pleaaase~~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh?! This place is...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hooray, hooray, hooraaay!
I'm finally back to my everyday life~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having pulled off a brilliant escape from her nightmare,
Matikanetannhauser felt completely refreshed!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Well... once in a while shouldn't hurt!
Ehehe, down the hatch~♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: "...Wait, taking a closer look, it's a wax food sample!If I ate that, I'd break out in hives!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: *Gasp*... Was it a dream...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of food that was in the end.
Fluffy sea urchin...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having had such a bizarre dream, Matikanetannhauser couldn't quite get her groove back...
